# Fallout 76: Patch notes Patch 55 (October 22, 2024)

![Fallout 76: Patch Notes Patch 55 (October 22, 2024)](/uploads/419_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Today we release our latest update for Fallout 76, which includes improvements for Appalachia. Read on to familiarize yourself with the full patch notes.

Update version 1.7.15.12 and download sizesHere you can find out the download size of today's update on the respective platform:

- PC (Steam): 2.5GB
- PC (Microsoft Store): 15.7GB
- Xbox: 19.8GB
- PlayStation: 15.1GB

Armor

- The compass in the power armor HUD now displays icons correctly.
- Power Armor: Fixed a bug where different combinations of torso paint jobs and jetpack skins would cause the selection made to change when opening the Power Armor menu.
- Secret Service armor now grants scrap when salvaged.
- Fixed a bug that occurred when players had multiple mining helmets that caused the lamp on the mining helmet to not work. Best build

- Best Build: Added a display image icon to the submission window. C.A.M.P. and workshops

- The pheasant plush toy now faces the intended direction in the workbench preview.
- All players who have the “Blueprint: Shepherd’s Bell (Basic)” can now craft the bell at their crafting workbench.
- Fixed a bug that caused some variants of the Blue Ridge Station Sentry to float in the air after being deployed.
- Fixed a bug that caused the destroyed farm cart to play its VFX repeatedly when fast traveling to the C.A.M.P. was used.
- Fixed a bug that caused the Scout Pioneer recruitment poster to not display correctly.
- Red Nuka-Cola wind chimes now make sounds as intended.
- Removed a non-functional power connector in the Sentry C.A.M.P. building.
- The Jumpy Juice visitor tea machine now correctly informs that it is making tea.
**Workshop:** The Atom Bulldozer preview icon has been adjusted to show the Bulldozer larger.
**Workshop:** Fixed a bug that could cause objects to protrude into parts of the metal stage and wooden stage.
**Workshop:** Fixed a bug that caused the Vault-Tec Fusion Core Charger to not display correctly when repaired while broken.
**Workshop:** The “Triumph Terrace” addition has been removed from the townhouse naming.
**Workshop:** Crafting the Small Flatbed now requires 1 Concrete, 2 Steel, and 3 Wood.
**Workshop:** The Triumph Terrace Screen Door now has sound effects.
**Workshop:** The Straw Goat can now properly be crafted by players who have learned the blueprint.Caravans

- Reworked some places where the Brahmin could get stuck, preventing any progress.
- Reworked some places where the Brahmin could get stuck, preventing any progress.
- Fixed a bug where a sprint speed boost for the Brahmin could affect all active Caravan Brahmin.
- Fixed a bug that allowed additional Yao Guai to spawn after completing the "Kill the Yao Guai" objective.
- Reworked some places where the Brahmin could get stuck, preventing any progress.
- Fixed a bug that allowed players to fully replenish their supplies on other players' caravans.
- Caravans that players have joined are now displayed in the “Events” tab in Pip-Boy.
**Challenges:** Completing a caravan now properly contributes to the Complete an Event challenge
